stories.title: Why Rocket Lab shares fell despite record revenue and booming Neutron demand
stories.summary: Rocket Lab shares fell more than 6% in after-hours trading on November 9 after the space company reported a wider-than-expected quarterly loss. The decline came despite record revenue, a growing order backlog and rising demand for its upcoming Neutron rocket.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
stories.summary: Meta Superintelligence Lab released a new AI model on Monday called Muse Ember, the lab’s lightest and most cost-efficient AI model yet. Given the emphasis on low cost and accuracy at scale, Ember is designed to pair with a larger model like Meta’s Muse Wonder in an agentic harness.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.
